title: Arabella in the AI chase scene

segments.text: I'm thinking of an idea where we have Arabella in this really interesting fight scene that I saw on Higgs Field AI.
It'd be great to find that video.
Use Arabella's character to run that chase, to jump over things.
Ivy, I just realized I need to get milk if you're able to put a little reminder in there.

Arabella runs through that scene. She jumps, she pushes away from people. It's a really cool AI scene, but using Arabella instead of the original performer in the actual video. When she gets to the end she has Ivy in her hand and says into the mic, it's done. Then it goes to the Ivy branding logo.

cards.title: Arabella runs the AI chase scene
cards.gist: Recreate a Higgs Field AI fight/chase scene with Arabella's character jumping and pushing past people, ending with her speaking into the mic — "it's done" — before cutting to the Ivy branding logo.
cards.their_idea: An AI-generated fight and chase scene on Higgs Field AI featuring the original performer running and leaping through a crowd.
cards.her_take: Swap in Arabella as the character running the chase, and land it on a mic line and the Ivy logo.

loose_ends.text: Find the Higgs Field AI fight/chase video that inspired this.

requests.text: Put a reminder in to get milk.
